proofMetadata.note: rev.8: T2 report format expected={ERR_LENGTH,ERR_TIMEOUT} (two transport-defined valid semantics, not 'accepted unexpected'); PHASE 7 rows -> transport=/expected=/observed=/passed= format. T8 upgraded to 3-way golden-vector cross-validation (tools/gen_golden_vectors.py off-device -> tools/golden_vectors.txt committed; device emits vector bytes; aios-verify.sh diffs -> HIL FAIL on drift). -DAIOS_BRIDGE_SMOKE mode (T0/T1/T2/T6/T8 only, skip T3/T4/T5/T7/throughput) for first physical-S3 bring-up. AIOS_S3_Bridge short-frame -> <ERR_TIMEOUT> status.

hardware.masterMCU: Renesas RA4M1 (R7FA4M1AB3CFM), Cortex-M4 @ 48 MHz, 32768 B SRAM

hwTrngNist.verdictRule: multi-comparison aware: hard p<1e-4 or >=2 soft p<0.01

bridgeE2E.linkMode: MODELED (no physical link detected). Auto-upgrades: aios_bridge_probe_s3() -> AIOS_LINK_S3_UART if an ESP32-S3 running AIOS_S3_Bridge.ino answers; else aios_bridge_probe_serial1() -> AIOS_LINK_SERIAL1 for a D0<->D1 jumper.

cases.name: S3 status byte vs independent echo re-verify agreement
cases.note: modeled: trivially PASS; physical S3: catches any drift of the S3 wire_verify from firmware/esp32s3_bridge.cpp

bridgeE2E.proves: wire protocol + link layer (framing, CRC, timeout/retry, replay window, error classification, fault-storm recovery)
bridgeE2E.doesNotProve: bridge firmware running on real ESP32-S3 silicon over a real R4<->S3 SPI/UART link (AIOS_ESP32S3_BRIDGE_E2E, still PENDING)
bridgeE2E.modeledCaveat: T4 (200/200) and T7 (10/10) counts and the ~380 kB/s / ~84 us benchmark are over the modeled transport, not a physical S3 link.
bridgeE2E.s3StatusCrossCheck: round_trip compares the S3-reported status byte against an independent aios_wire_verify() of the echoed 32 bytes (stateless verdict); REPLAY/TIMEOUT allowed to differ (stateful/transport).
bridgeE2E.reportFormat: transport=<mode> expected={CODE[,ALT]} observed=<CODE> passed=<0|1>; T2 has two valid codes by transport

T8.name: golden-vector cross-validation (3-way)
T8.hostCrossCheck: aios-verify.sh diffs the logged GOLDEN lines against tools/golden_vectors.txt -> HIL FAIL on any drift
T8.rationale: a bug shared by RA4M1 and S3 wire_verify is still caught because the golden expected verdict is an independent constant

bridgeE2E.smokeMode: -DAIOS_BRIDGE_SMOKE -> PHASE 7 runs T0/T1/T2/T6 + T8 golden only (skip T3/T4/T5/T7 + throughput). For the first physical-S3 bring-up run before any performance number is taken.

offDeviceTrngBattery.tool: tools/nist_sts_lite.py (independent re-implementation, NOT the NIST STS reference)

closureSequence: register [self-hosted, aios-hil] runner restricted to this repo
confirm aios-verify.sh + workflow accept CONDITIONAL_PASS (already do)
master branch protection -> require hil-proof status check
after real-S3 E2E: PHASE_7_REAL_S3_SILICON_E2E=PASS -> verdict auto PASS -> regenerate release report
hilCi.preFlashGate: workflow step 'src/ in sync + both sketches compile clean' runs sync --check + arduino-cli compile for AIOS_HardwareProof and (if esp32 core present) AIOS_S3_Bridge before the on-silicon proof step
hilCi.cleanCheckoutBuild: git archive <commit> | tar -x  ->  arduino-cli compile  ->  EXIT 0 (no sync/setup step); verified for both sketches at commit d427691
